title: LLM Quantization: What fp8 and fp4 Do to Quality and Price
excerpt: When you call an open-weight model through an API, several providers may serve it at different precisions, such as 16-bit bf16, 8-bit fp8 or 4-bit fp4. The precision can affect both the answers and the price. LLM quantization creates these versions by storing a model's weights in fewer bits, so the model needs less memory and hardware, at some cost in accuracy.
